prompt:
Image 1 is a style reference only: match its painting style, brushwork, lighting, rim light, framing, background and proportions. The person, the face, the headgear and every ornament must be different from Image 1 and must follow the description below exactly; do not copy the man, the helm, the horns or the trim from Image 1.

Head-and-shoulders portrait bust of one fantasy war leader, three-quarter view, the face turned toward the right side of the image. Square image. Framing: the top of the head or headgear about 9% from the top edge, the eyes about 39% from the top, the chin about 62% from the top, the image cut at mid-chest, with dark empty space above and around the head. One figure only. No hands, no weapons raised toward the face, no text, no border, no frame, no signature, no logo.
Lighting: a single warm candle key light from the upper left, a dim warm fill, deep warm shadows, and a thin soft warm rim light along the back of the head or headgear, the hair and the shoulders that separates the whole silhouette clearly from the background. Background: plain, unpatterned, very dark warm brown close to #1C1A17, with no objects.
Medium: painterly oil on a wood panel, visible brushwork, moderate detail, a strong readable silhouette: the shape of the headgear or hair and the light face against the dark background must still read when the image is shrunk to 48 pixels.
Colors: muted and earthy. Nothing in the image glows, except where the subject below says a mage's eyes glow. No saturated red, orange, green or blue area larger than a small clasp or trim.

Subject: A captain of a free village militia: a weathered human face, plain leather and iron, no insignia.
An Independent Captain in hunter's gear: a fur-trimmed hood.
Person: a man about fifty, a long horse face, weathered brown skin, deep-set dark eyes, long greying black hair loose under the hood, a thin drooping moustache, a notched ear, a tired distant look. Kit: a hood of oiled mid-brown leather with a thick, clearly visible rim of sleek dark otter fur all around the face opening; a leather strap with three iron rings across the chest.
